cards.title: Bail Organa
issues: Retrieval clause fires once per Force card lost: justLostForceFromForceDrainAt(..., false) offers 'retrieve 1 Force' for every unit of a multi-Force drain (test BailOrganaMayRespondToEachUnitActuallyLostToTwoForceRebelDrain asserts 2 retrievals from one 2-Force drain). Printed text gives one retrieval per Force drain.

review.fix_instructions: Card1250_034.getGameTextOptionalAfterTriggers: pass isFirstForceOnly=true to TriggerConditions.justLostForceFromForceDrainAt (or trigger once per completed drain) so a single Force drain yields at most one 'Retrieve 1 Force'. Rewrite the two-unit test to assert exactly one retrieval offer for a 2-Force drain.
review.notes: Everything else (agenda, Leia destiny, Coruscant senator/Political Effect loss, Senate +2 power to unique Rebels ability<4) is correct.

pc_front.gametext: Agenda: rebellion. Adds one battle destiny with Leia. Your [Coruscant] senators and [Coruscant] Political Effects are lost. While at Senate: unique (•) Rebels of ability < 4 are power +2, and, if opponent just lost Force to a Force drain by a Rebel, may retrieve 1 Force.
pc_front.title: •Bail Organa

title: Implement Legacy An Enemy Of The Republic

cards.title: An Enemy Of The Republic
issues: Relocation target omits 'non-droid': PC gametext says 'opponent must relocate this card to their participating non-droid character' (OVS 1116_40 also says non-droid). Worker followed the hosted image wording instead.

review.shared_changes: Appends one GameTextActionId constant at the enum tail (safe; textual conflict with other PRs appending at the same line, trivial to resolve).
review.fix_instructions: In relocateToBattle add Filters.not(Filters.droid) to the participating-character filter, update setGameText to the PC wording ('participating non-droid character'), and flip the droid test (AnEnemyOfTheRepublicLetsLightChooseParticipatingDroid...) to assert a droid is NOT offered. If Bill/PC rules the image wording (no non-droid) is current, this becomes READY as is. Rest is correct: deploy on Sidious, uncancelable own destiny in battle here, return to Sidious when bearer about to be lost with optional Reserve search.

pc_front.gametext: Deploy on Sidious. While at Senate, if battle was just initiated anywhere, opponent must relocate this card to their participating non-droid character; during battle here, your destiny draws may not be canceled. If character about to be lost, relocate to Sidious; may take any one card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
pc_front.title: •An Enemy Of The Republic

title: Implement Legacy Expand The Empire and Order 66

cards.title: Expand The Empire (V)
issues: Cosmetic: setGameText reorders the lost-card list and lore uses double quotes vs PC single quotes.

cards.title: Order 66
issues: Adds Icon.CORUSCANT, which is not on the PC card (icons: Episode I, Sidious) nor on the card image.

review.fix_instructions: Order 66 (Card1250_020): remove Icon.CORUSCANT from addIcons (keep SIDIOUS, LEGACY_BLOCK_5; EPISODE_I inherited) and drop CORUSCANT from Order66PrintedMetadataMatches icon expectation. Gameplay is correct: control-phase relocation to an [Episode I] Jedi at battleground/Senate when with Block 5 Expand, else retrieve 1; adds battle destiny when on a Jedi; returns to Sidious when that Jedi is lost (OVS 'Jedi lost at end of turn' correctly dropped). Optional: match PC gametext order/lore quotes on Expand.

pc_front.gametext: Deploy on Senate. May raise your converted Senate to the top. Jedi here are politics +4. While your total politics here is > 5, at battlegrounds where you have an Imperial, your Force drains and battle destiny draws are +1. Your aliens (except Mara), senators, Maul, and [Independent Starship] starships are lost. (Immune to Alter.)
pc_front.lore: The Emperor disbanded the Imperial Senate 'for the duration of the emergency,' seizing absolute power. He planned to extend rule by terrorizing planets into submission.
pc_front.title: •Expand The Empire (V)

pc_front.gametext: Deploy on Sidious. If with [Virtual Block 5] Expand the Empire during your control phase: relocate this card to an [Episode I] Jedi at a battleground or Senate (otherwise, retrieve 1 Force). If on a Jedi, add one battle destiny here, and if that Jedi just lost, relocate this card to Sidious.
pc_front.title: •Order 66

cards.title: Senator Padme Amidala
issues: Title is 'Senator Padmé Amidala' (accented). PC title and the OVS 1116_004 on master use 'Senator Padme Amidala'; no master card uses an accented Padmé title.
'If just lost from same site as Vader, place her out of play; opponent loses 4 Force' not implemented.

review.fix_instructions: 1) Change the title to 'Senator Padme Amidala'. 2) Add a required trigger: TriggerConditions.justLostFromLocation(game, result, self, Filters.sameSiteAs(self, Filters.Vader)) (pattern in Card210_046) -> place her out of play from Lost Pile and make the opponent of her owner lose 4 Force; test with Vader at the same site (out of play, opponent -4) and elsewhere (nothing). The simultaneous-loss edge case can be a note, not a blocker.
review.notes: Agendas, both affiliations, and the once-per-turn lose-1 Lost Pile deploy (unique, non-maintenance Rebel ability < 4, at Senate with Bail) are implemented and tested.

pc_front.gametext: Agendas: justice, rebellion. Once per turn, if at Senate with Bail, may lose 1 Force to deploy a unique (•), non-[Maintenance] Rebel of ability < 4 from Lost Pile. If just lost from same site as Vader, place her out of play; opponent loses 4 Force.
pc_front.title: •Senator Padme Amidala
